commands_run: cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core iris 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-core hestia::tests::oly_b_set_04 2>&1
cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1; cargo test -p xtask 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-core 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: grep -n "OLY-B-SET-04" -B2 -A14 docs/spec.toml | head -50; sed -n 1,40p CHANGELOG.md; grep -n "pub mod invocation\|pub mod jev" -B3 -A3 crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs; sed -n 4280,4320p crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs; sed -n 40,75p crates/athena-core/tests/model_roster.rs
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core iris 2>&1 | tail -25; cargo test -p athena-core hestia::tests::oly_b_set_04 2>&1 | tail -8

cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -n 15; cargo test -p xtask --test policy 2>&1 | tail -n 15; cargo test -p xtask 2>&1 | tail -n 15; cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors 2>&1 | tail -n 8; cargo test -p athena-core 2>&1 | tail -n 12

cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 | grep -E "^(warning|error)|Finished" ; cargo test -p xtask 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|failed|panicked"; cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|failed|panicked"; cargo test -p athena-core 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|failed|panicked"

cargo clippy -q --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings >/dev/null 2>&1; echo clippy=$?; cargo fmt --all --check >/dev/null 2>&1; echo fmt=$?; cargo test -q -p xtask >/dev/null 2>&1; echo xtask=$?; cargo test -q -p athena-cli --test mirrors >/dev/null 2>&1; echo mirrors=$?; cargo test -q -p athena-core >/dev/null 2>&1; echo core=$?
